accepted_claims: Selected the next source-backed GPIO32/ETH_RST_N prerequisite boundary as a local/static read-only preflight report contract only.
Retained Pi 5 device-tree source identifies rp1_eth phy-reset-gpios as rp1_gpio line 32 with GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW polarity and phy-reset-duration 5 ms.

Linux MACB source obtains the optional phy-reset GPIO as GPIOD_OUT_LOW, installs macb_mdio_reset as the MDIO bus reset hook, asserts the logical reset value 1, sleeps phy_reset_ms, then deasserts logical value 0.
For the active-low ETH_RST_N route, logical assertion value 1 corresponds to physical low and logical deassertion value 0 corresponds to physical high.
Accepted Phase 11 GPIO frontiers leave GPIO ownership, function changes, RIO/pad/INTE/CTRL writes, event generation, and GPIO write/restore authority unaccepted.
The selected follow-up is phase12-rp1-ethernet-gpio32-phy-reset-preflight-core-20260610, limited to local/static candidate/control report construction.
